no_server_configured: No Palworld server configured yet. Add one on the plugin settings page.
no_server_resolved: No server selected for this session. Admins can authorize with /pal link add <name>, or use /pal link list to view servers.
server_unknown: Server "{server}" does not exist or is not ready.
not_authorized: This session is not authorized to use server "{server}". Ask an admin to run /pal link add {server} first.
link_single_mode: Single-world mode is active; no server selection needed: every action targets the one server.
group_no_actions: No commands available in this group (it may be disabled or require admin).

single_not_authorized: This group is not authorized to query this server. Send /pal whereami in the group to get its ID, then have an admin add it to the authorized-groups list under the "Connection" section of the plugin settings page.
setup_required: 🔧 PalWorldTerminal has not completed first-time setup. Open the plugin settings page, choose a run mode (single-server / multi-server), and confirm to start using it.
active_server_stale: The currently bound server is no longer available. Ask an admin to run /pal link add <name> again.
degraded: 🔴 World data unavailable right now · last succeeded {minutes} min ago
degraded_never: 🔴 Never connected to the server yet; check the "Connection" settings
